first_line: Now the heavens start to whisper
Come now, O God, when our love is forsaken
Oh, freedom, oh, freedom
Tú, Jesús, nuestra esperanza (Come to be our hope, O Jesus)
We are waiting for Jesus
No wind at the window, no knock on the door
Filled with hope and gratitude and filled with very God
In a far-off place
Where shepherds lately knelt and kept the angel's word
A stable lamp is lighted
Gloria a Dios, gloria a Dios (Glory to God, glory to God)
Noche anunciada (Night long-awaited)
While shepherds watched their flocks by night
Hark! The herald andgels sing
When a star is shining over eastern hills
Down Galilee's slow roadways
Dazzling presence on the mountain
Now is the time of grace
Remember that you are dust
All things of dust to dust return
In all affliction return
When we are tested and wrestle alone
As your Spirit in the desert
As the winter days grow longer
All this pain
Surely God is my salvation
Christ is the life of all that is
Jesus is coming
Blessed is the one who comes in the name
Three holy days enfold us now
Una sala y una mesa (One assembly at one table)
Santo Cordero, en cruz clavado (Lamb of God most holy, upon the cross extended)
Day of delight and beauty unbounded
Cristo vive, fuera el llanto (Christ is living! Gone with sorrow!)
Woman, weeping in the garden
The day of resurrection!
Earth, earth, awake! Your praises sing!
Christ has risen while earth slumbers
Touch that soothes and helas the hurting
Come, Holy Spirit
Breathe on us, Breath of God
Upon the mountain my Lord spoke
As the wind song though the trees
O Spirit all-embracing and counselor all-wise
Manifold are your works, O God of might
The play of the Godhead, the Trinity's dance
Source and Sov'reign, Rock and Cloud
Womb of life, and source of being
Keep you lamps trimmed and burning
Oh, when the saints go marching in
Oh, don't you want to go to that gospel feast
The reign of God, like farmer's field
Before the Ancient One, Christ stands
You, Lord, are both Lamb and Shepherd
All who are thirsty for mercy
Drown us, Raise us
Take me to the water
To Christ belong, in Christ behold
Life-gving water soaking our dryness
Oi Jumalan Karitsa joka pois otat maailman synnin (O Lamb of God, you take away the sin of the world)
Come to the table
Tässä pöydässä (In this feast of love)
Jesus Christ, our blessed Savior
Aquí del pan partido tomaré (Here would I feast upon the bread of God)
The rice of life from heaven came
Loaves were broken, words wer spoken
This is Christ's body
Feed us with hunger for justice
I'm agoin'-a eat at the welcome table
We come now to your table, Lord
Come and seek the ways of Wisdom
Come, Holy Spirit, melt and break our hearts of stone
Palabra que fue luz el primer día (The Word who sang the light into creation)
Listen to the word that God has spoken
O God, whose word well-planted
What are you looking for?
Look who gathers at Christ's table!
God welcomes all
Making their way down through the ages
Come, Holy Spirit
All who are thirsty, come to the waters
Many will come from east and west, and from north and south
Now the meal is over
¡Dios de la esperanaza, danos gozo y paz! (May the God of hope go with us ev'ry day)
Let us enter into the song of thanksgiving and freedom
Bwana awabariki (May God bless us and keep us)
Guide my feet while I run this race
The Spirit sends us forth to serve
Yarabba ssalami (Let your peace rain upon us)
Ho, ho ho! Sizohamba naye! (Ho, ho ho! We will gow with God!)
Go to the world! Go into all the earth
Now that the daylight fills the sky
Dios está aquí (God is here today)
The night you gave us, God, has ended
Te invitamos, oh Cristo (Come, be among us, O Jesus)
Tend your ailing ones; in yor love, Lord
Behold, unveiled the vesper skies
In silence we wait
Your canopy of vigil lights
Gods work, our hands
Holy woman, graceful giver
Holy woman, graceful giver
Could it be that we are called
Faith begins by letting go
Ask the complicated questions
On the days when you are weak
Khudaya, rahm kar
Por esos hierros que te clavaron (For cold and cruel nails that impale you)
Woza nomthwalo wakho (Come, bring your burdens to God)
Corre el viento in esta gran cieudad (Wind and cold roar through the city street)
Holy God
To you all hearts are open
Anointing fall on me
When we must bear persistent pain
As a mother comforts her child
Cast out, O Christ, cast far away
Come to me, O weary trav'ler
Deep peace of the running waves
Lord Jesus Christ
Let my spirit always sing
O God, to you I cry in pain
God, bless the hands stretched out in love
Oceans rise, the coastland trembles
There's no other place I can hide
If we live, we live to the Lord
In the midst of earthly life
Don't be afraid
When eyes that we once knew as keen
In the peace of God find rest
We walk in light of countless faces
Mon âme se repose en paix sur Dieu seul (In God alone my soul can find rest and peace)
Lift up your heads, all you bowed low
Nada te turbe (Nothing can trouble)
When it seems the day will end
Though the earth shall change
Commonwelath is God's commandment
Christ our peace
God, we gather as your people to raise our sing above
Hine ma tov umah naim
Love has broght us here together
God is love
Que esta iglesia sea un árbol (May this church be like a tree)
tune: QUE ESTA IGLESIA SEA UN ÁRBOL

first_line: God, replace my stony heart
Not for tongues of heaven's angels
Come, share the Spirit, God has called us
As rivers flow from a distant spring
What is the world like when God's will is done?
Founded on faith, the church— alive by grace
Before the watrs nourished earth
Sometimes our only song is weeping
Pelas dores deste mund, ó Senhor (For the troubles and the suff'rings of the world)
When our world is rent by violence
En Babilonia hay ríos con sus álamos en flor (A river flows through Babylon and poplars line the shore)
God weeps with us who weep and mourn
Ayúdanos, oh Dios
Bendice, Señor,nuestro pan (God bless to us our bread)
What does the Lord require of you?
Let not the needy be forgotten
Come now, you blessed
Gentle Josph heard a warning
Caminemos con Jesús
Build a longer table, not a higher wall
God of the fertile fields
Earth is full of wit and wisdom
Can you feel the seasons turning
Al caer la lluvia, resurge converdor (When at last the rain falls, our world turns living green)
We lift this prayer for the wholeness of the earth
The earth adorned in verdant robe
God bestows on ev'ry sense
Los cielos cuentan la gloria de Dios (The heavens tell of your creative glory)
In sacred manner may we walk
"Abba, Abba, hear us," we cry
Kyrie eleison
Óyenos, Seńor
O God, we call
Search me, O God, and know my heart
In peace, may we assemble
For justice
Open my heart, open my heart
Lord, I will lift mine eyse to the hills
When mem'ry fades and recognition falters
O God, you search me and you know me
Be still and know that I am God
God, be the love to search and keep me
Hope of the world, O Christ of great compassion
O God, who gives us life and breath
Glory to God, whose goodness shines on me
Halle, hallelujah
Santo, santo, santo, oh Dios del universo (Holy, holy, holy, Lord God of might and mercy)
Heaven opened to Isaiah
Hallelujah! Sing praise to your Creator
Thank you, Lord
In a deep, unbounded darkness
Bring many names, beautiful and good
How shall I sing that majesty
Joyful is the dark
The sun comes up, it's a new day dawning
Quién, quién, quién como Jehová (Who, who, who is like our God)
Kneeling in the dust to form us
O beauty ever ancient
